description: Route messages based on multiple field conditions with AND/OR logic combinations.

data_input.info: The input data (Data or Message) to evaluate conditions against.

conditions.info: Configure multiple conditions for routing logic. Click 'Load Fields' to populate field options from upstream data.
conditions.compare_value_info: The value to compare against. For 'in list' operators, use comma-separated values.

combination_logic.info: Choose how to combine multiple conditions: AND (all must be true) or OR (any can be true).

input_text.info: The primary text input for the operation (legacy mode).

operator.info: The operator to apply for comparing the texts.

match_text.info: The text input to compare against.

case_sensitive.info: If true, the comparison will be case sensitive.

true_case_message.info: The message to pass if the condition is True.

false_case_message.info: The message to pass if the condition is False.

max_iterations.info: The maximum number of iterations for the conditional router.

default_route.info: The default route to take when max iterations are reached.

status.forced_true: Max iterations (%{iteration}) reached - forcing True output
status.forced_false: Max iterations (%{iteration}) reached - forcing False output
status.fields_loaded: Successfully loaded %{count} fields from upstream data

warnings.invalid_number: Invalid number format for comparison - Input: '%{input_text}', Match: '%{match_text}', Error: %{error}
warnings.empty_field_name: Condition has empty field name, skipping
warnings.no_graph_data_placeholder: PlaceholderGraph detected - no graph data available
warnings.no_upstream_data: No data returned from upstream node
warnings.upstream_failed: Upstream execution failed: %{error}. Trying static analysis...
warnings.no_fields_found_error: No fields found in upstream configuration

errors.field_not_found: Field '%{field}' not found in upstream data
errors.no_graph_data_error: No graph data available for field loading

logs.pre_run_setup: Pre-run setup completed - iteration counter reset
logs.condition_true: Condition evaluated to True - routing to true branch
logs.condition_false: Condition evaluated to False - routing to false branch
logs.forced_true_output: Forced True output due to max iterations: %{iteration}
logs.forced_false_output: Forced False output due to max iterations: %{iteration}
logs.removed_case_sensitive: Removed case_sensitive field for regex operator
logs.added_case_sensitive: Added case_sensitive field to build config
logs.condition_evaluated: Condition evaluated - Field: %{field}, Operator: %{operator}, Value: %{value}, Compare: %{compare}, Result: %{result}
logs.and_short_circuit: AND logic short-circuit: condition failed, returning False
logs.or_short_circuit: OR logic short-circuit: condition succeeded, returning True
logs.no_graph_available: No graph available for field extraction
logs.no_graph_data: No graph data available for field extraction
logs.no_fields_found: No fields found in upstream configuration
logs.field_options_updated: Updated field options with %{count} available fields
logs.loading_fields: Loading field options from upstream data
logs.trying_data_extraction: Schema extraction empty, trying data extraction as fallback

no_conditions_added: No conditions added. Click 'Add Condition' to get started.

instructions.field_selection: Select a field from upstream data to compare against.
instructions.operator_selection: Choose an appropriate operator for the field type.
instructions.list_format: For 'in list' operators, enter comma-separated values (e.g., 'value1,value2,value3').
